Subject: MAP draft & post-call recap — Redwood + Acme Healthcare

Hi Emily — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and attached MAP draft (MAP_v1.xlsx). I captured the milestones we discussed during discovery and the suggested responsibilities. High-level:

- Goal: Pilot of Redwood inference runtime for ACME clinical search by end of Q2.
- Initial pilot: 2 models, 1 region (us-west) — timeline: 4 weeks for integration, 2 weeks for pilot validation.
- Responsibilities: Acme IT for network & firewall, Acme Clinical team for acceptance criteria, Redwood for runtime & onboarding.
- Dependencies: Data access, account setup, SOC 2 checklist items (we have a separate thread for security).

Next steps I proposed on the call:
1) Review MAP draft and confirm owners (Emily + Procurement) — target reply by EOD Tue 4/21
2) Redwood to deliver updated integration checklist (attached)
3) Schedule technical kickoff once procurement timeline is clear

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (attached), draft map in Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=map-acme-2026

Thanks — I can iterate quickly.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference — developer-first inference runtime

From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@acmehealth.com>

Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & post-call recap — Redwood + Acme Healthcare

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the MAP. A couple of updates from our side after talking with procurement:

- Procurement has pushed our internal approval cycle out by ~6 weeks due to a vendor consolidation review. That means our realistic target close moves from end of Q2 to ~2026-06-30.
- Given the timeline, the Clinical team is reprioritizing. They want to abbreviate the pilot scope: limit to one model and focus on the critical query set first. They also want clearer acceptance criteria for pilot success.
- Procurement asked for an updated MAP and a simple statement of work (SOW) summary to attach to their packet. I'm attaching our internal procurement timeline for visibility (acme_procurement_timeline.pdf).

Can you update the MAP and reprioritize milestones accordingly? Also please include a single point of contact for our security questionnaire so procurement can close that loop faster.

I'll loop back once I have formal dates from procurement but expect the new target close to be ~2026-06-30.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Torres
Head of Clinical Data Partnerships | Acme Healthcare
emily.torres@acmehealth.com

What I'll do now:
- Produce MAP_v2 with reprioritized milestones (single-model pilot, tightened acceptance criteria), and a 1-page SOW summary for procurement.
- Assign a single security contact: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com (he will be the liaison for the questionnaire).
- Note dependencies: network & data access still required before kickoff; we'll document fallback dates in the MAP if procurement takes longer.

Rishi / Dev — can you review the timeline changes below and confirm feasibility? Proposed high-level updates:
- Target close: 2026-06-30
- Integration window: 4-6 weeks after PO depending on data access
- Pilot scope: 1 model (reduced validation) — acceptance criteria to be trimmed to top 10 clinical queries 
- Milestones:
  * M1: PO signed (Acme) — target 2026-05-15 (pushable)
  * M2: Integration kickoff (Redwood + Acme IT) — within 2 weeks of PO
  * M3: Pilot completion & acceptance testing — 4 weeks after kickoff

I'll attach MAP_v2 once we confirm. Emily — do these high-level milestones match what procurement needs to see?

Best,
Marissa

Team — quick internal note following Emily's update. Procurement pushed approval ~6 weeks; customer wants a smaller pilot. Please confirm the items below by EOD Monday 4/20 so I can fold into MAP_v2: 

- Rishi: confirm you'll own security questionnaire replies and provide SOC 2 evidence bundle. If procurement asks for an encrypted artifact transfer, let me know.
